data.name: Jaidul
data.gender_notes: Jaidul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jai: victory, Dul: God. The name Jaidul is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it is a powerful name in Hindu tradition. It is believed that the name Jaidul is given to a child who will be victorious in all aspects of life, with the blessings and support of God. The name Jaidul carries the meaning “Victory of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaidul usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the blessings of God be with you, leading you to victory in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Jaidul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaidul total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jaidul denotes power, strength, and success in Hindu culture. It is believed that individuals with this name are destined for great achievements and triumphs. Furthermore, the name Jaidul is auspicious and is often given to children during significant religious ceremonies or during auspicious occasions.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Jaidul represents the triumph of the spiritual self over the material self. It signifies the victory of dharma (righteousness) over adharma (unrighteousness). The name Jaidul is also believed to provide protection and blessings from the Gods, especially Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. Jaidul is a divine name that inspires faith, devotion, and a strong sense of spiritual purpose.

historical_references.reference: The name Jaidul has been used throughout Hindu history by sages, scholars, and devotees who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jaidul remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
